slides.headline: Nvidia expects [$108B] this quarter. Is that enough?

slides.title: Nvidia sales, same quarter each year
slides.text: Check 1: did sales beat the [$108B] forecast?

slides.title: Check 2: beat what, exactly?
paras: Aug 2025: Nvidia guided <g>$54B</g>, above what analysts expected. The stock still fell 2.5% after hours. Some analysts had hoped for over $60B.

slides.title: Check 3: the next forecast
paras: The new outlook for next quarter often moves the stock more than the last quarter does. Not financial advice.

sources: Nvidia IR: Q3 FY24 revenue $18.12B, Q3 FY25 $35.08B, Q3 FY26 $57.0B (+62% y/y, Neowin/Outlook Business); Q2 FY27 $96.2B; Q3 FY27 outlook $108.0B +/-2%; results ~1:20pm PT Nov 17, call 2pm PT
Aug 27 2025: Q3 FY26 outlook $54.0B +/-2% vs LSEG consensus $53.14B, shares -2.5% after hours, some analysts projected >$60B (TipRanks/TheFly, BNN Bloomberg, Advisor Perspectives/Bloomberg)
